quarterly_data.signal: Rambus announced its CryptoManager Root of Trust supporting the Caliptra specification, which it describes as a production-ready Root of Trust and security orchestration solution for data center and AI SoCs. It operates alongside an unmodified open-source Caliptra core (the open silicon Root of Trust initiated through the Open Compute Project, now developed in the CHIPS Alliance) and combines a secure RISC-V processor, protected memory, secure key and data storage, cryptographic accelerators and secure interfaces, with drivers, APIs and security applications; it supports classical, post-quantum and regional cryptographic algorithms, side-channel and fault-injection protections, and certification support for FIPS 140-3 and SESIP. SVP/GM Silicon IP Simon Blake-Wilson: it provides 'the hardware, software, advanced protections and commercial support needed to accelerate deployment'.
